verdict.rationale: ELSTER's own docs say powers of attorney (Vollmachten) can be filed electronically with the tax office, and that organisations can appoint mailbox representatives (Postfachvertreter) who may view inbox messages. That is a documented delegation mechanism with one defined role. But the evidence never sets out what a representative may and may not do, which forms apply, or which acts or signatures stay personal. Missing for 10: published authorization forms and their scope, a full role catalogue with permitted and forbidden actions, explicit rules on which signatures or declarations cannot be delegated, and independent corroboration.
